fixed_point.nearest_even: choose the nearest integer; exact ties choose the even integer, including negative ties

drift.stored_displacement: nearest_even((N/D)*2^Fpos), then signed position-grid range check
drift.stored_position: r_raw + stored_displacement, then signed position-grid range check
drift.exact_endpoint: r_raw / 2^Fpos + N/D; independent of stored rounding

kick.range: check each updated momentum in the signed momentum-grid range

order: mass_i,mass_j,dt if drift or J_raw if kick
validation.integers: type must be exactly int, not bool/float
validation.vectors: immutable tuples of exactly three lanes
validation.rational_input: exact integer pair with positive denominator; API permits unreduced pairs; wire requires coprime pair and zero 0/1
validation.dt: signed exact rational, including zero, for arithmetic kernel only
validation.wire: strict JSON, duplicate/unknown keys rejected, canonical signed decimal strings, no numbers or bool for raw/rational values

drift_check_order: for each component in component_order: rounding, displacement range, stored-position range; then exact segment guard, then stored-position guard; publish only after all checks
kick_check_order: i.x/y/z subtraction and range, then j.x/y/z addition and range; publish after all checks

refusal.contract: same stable code, phase, atom, component and message in slow and fast; no partial publication or input mutation

geometry.input: exact rational 3-vectors q0,q1,stored_relative and positive exact r_min_squared
geometry.endpoint: q1 is exact unrounded drift relative endpoint
geometry.definition: v=q1-q0; A=q0 dot q0; B=q0 dot v; C=v dot v; if C=0 tau=0,min=A; else tau=max(0,min(1,-B/C)),min=|q0+tau*v|^2

canonical_candidate_binding.status: CANDIDATE INFORMATION ONLY; not a kernel default or physical approval
